interpretation: 1 of 10 contrasts survive BH correction: gender (all_features, gap +0.051, BH p 0.025). 7 contrasts have a gap smaller than the minimum detectable effect, so those are undetected rather than absent.
caveat: MDE uses the Hanley-McNeil AUC standard error with the pooled Fail share; it is an approximation, not a substitute for a proper equivalence test. A bootstrap p-value cannot fall below 1/repeats, so a surviving contrast whose p equals that floor is 'significant at the resolution of the bootstrap', not a measured tail probability. Rows where the gap exceeds the MDE but the interval crosses zero are reported separately instead of being folded into either conclusion.
